questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Quite easy. The Dutch aren't wildly different from the Danish.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Just strike up a conversation with the person next to you, they are probably also looking for someone to talk to

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The unwillingness to be flexible with rules or parameters even if the situation requires it.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: How progressive they are

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Prepare for multiple choice exams
It is much easier to fail a class there than here
The study spaces are limited so book in advance

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: no

questions.answer: Getting new friends from all around the world

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Combating the management of the housing company. Dutch landlords are out without morals
